sample_unit: LLM responses to metabolic health questions
unlisted_practices: Adaptive Precise Boolean rubrics as an evaluation method for LLM health responses, compared with Likert scales for inter-rater agreement and evaluation time
Automated (LLM-based) autoraters and non-expert raters used for scalable evaluation of open-ended health responses

screen.reason: The study empirically tests a novel evaluation and quality assurance methodology (Adaptive Precise Boolean rubrics vs. traditional Likert scales) for clinical LLM outputs, demonstrating improved inter-rater reliability and efficiency.

primary.practice: Adaptive Precise Boolean rubrics for evaluating model responses
